title: ctx e2e quarantine ledger (design 06 §3.5/§5.4, wave PV11)
description: The flake-quarantine ledger. A `@quarantine`-tagged spec is excluded from the per-PR mock-tier gate (grepInvert) but STILL run nightly (observed, not forgotten) — so it must be tracked here. Tag<->ledger is a 1:1 bijection (e2e/contract/quarantine.test.ts): a `@quarantine` tag without an entry is red (`untracked quarantine`), an entry without a tag is red (`stale`). The cap is > 5 entries => red (evaluateCap) — the quarantine cannot silently grow into an invisible heap. Adding an entry is a deliberate process decision (COVERAGE.md header rule: flaky twice within 14 days => quarantine or fix), never automatic. Empty is the healthy default.

title.description: The Playwright test title (leaf title of the `@quarantine`-tagged test). MUST match the tag holder exactly — the bijection test resolves tags structurally via `playwright test --list --reporter=json`.

issue.description: Mandatory tracking reference — GitHub-issue interim form until Achse-02 issues exist (§3.3/§9.4), never empty.

since.description: Date the test entered quarantine (YYYY-MM-DD) — the 14-day flake clock and the cap-age review read this.
